page: The Google Cloud Platform z4m-highmem-32 belongs to the storage-optimized virtual machine family, engineered to provide substantial local storage capacity combined with dedicated processing power. The system is provisioned with 32 dedicated vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture and 244.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 7.62 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance is not equipped with discrete GPU hardware, directing all host resources toward central processor calculations, memory transactions, and disk throughput.

Storage architecture is the defining attribute of the z4m-highmem-32 profile. The virtual machine includes 30,065 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, offering high local capacity directly connected to the host node. In terms of network configuration, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring private networking or separate address allocation for outbound or ingress traffic. From a resource-density perspective, pairing high-capacity local NVMe storage directly within the instance allows applications to avoid external network block storage overhead for data-intensive processing.

The combination of 32 dedicated execution cores, 244.0 GB of RAM, and over 30 TB of local NVMe SSD space makes this server suitable for high-density transactional databases, distributed storage nodes, data warehousing ingestion, and search indexing pipelines where low latency and high local disk space are mandatory.
description: The Google Cloud Platform z4m-highmem-32 is a storage-optimized virtual machine designed for I/O-intensive workloads requiring large amounts of fast local disk capacity. The configuration supplies 32 dedicated vCPUs built on x86_64 architecture alongside 244.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.62 GB of RAM per core. A central feature of this instance is its 30,065 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage, providing substantial direct-attached capacity without relying on external network volumes. The system does not feature GPU accelerators, focusing entirely on high-capacity memory, processing, and storage operations. Networking provisions include zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given its large local storage footprint and balanced compute allocation, the instance is tailored for large-scale relational or non-relational database management systems, distributed file systems, and real-time analytical indexing workloads.
